## 기본 개념

## 계급구분 방법

### 지도 제작 데이터

#### 필수적인 패키지


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse) 
library(scales)
library(readxl) 
library(sf) 
library(tmap) 
library(tmaptools)
library(rnaturalearth)
```
:::


#### 우리나라 데이터

- 도형 데이터


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
seoul_EMD_2020 <- read_sf(
  "D:/My R/Korean Administrative Areas/행정구역 셰이프 파일/2 Original Cleaning/2020_2Q/SEOUL_EMD_2020_2Q.shp", options = "ENCODING=CP949"
  ) 
seoul_gu <- read_sf(
  "D:/My R/Korean Administrative Areas/행정구역 셰이프 파일/2 Original Cleaning/2021_4Q/SEOUL_GU_2021_4Q.shp", options = "ENCODING=CP949"
  ) 
seoul_sido <- read_sf(
  "D:/My R/Korean Administrative Areas/행정구역 셰이프 파일/2 Original Cleaning/2021_4Q/SEOUL_SIDO_2021_4Q.shp", options = "ENCODING=CP949"
  )
```
:::


- 속성 데이터: 1인가구 비중


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
house_SDGGEMD_2020 <- read_excel(
  "D:/My R/Population Geography/3 Population Structure/Housing_Size_2020_Adj.xlsx", sheet = 1
  )
```
:::


- 결합하기


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
seoul_EMD_2020 <- seoul_EMD_2020 |> 
  mutate(
    EMD_ID = as.numeric(EMD_ID)
  )
seoul_df <-seoul_EMD_2020 |> 
  left_join(
    house_SDGGEMD_2020, join_by(EMD_ID == Code)
  )
```
:::


#### 세계 데이터

- 도형 데이터


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
countries_m <- read_sf("D:/My R/World Data Manupulation/NaturalEarth/new_2_ne_50m_admin_0_countries.shp") 
tiny_m <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "tiny_countries", category = "cultural", returnclass = "sf")
grat_bb_m <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "wgs84_bounding_box", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
grat_10_m <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "graticules_10", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
grat_30_m <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "graticules_30", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

tiny_m <- tiny_m |> 
  mutate(
    ISO_N3_CD = as.numeric(ISO_N3)
  )
```
:::


- 속성 데이터: TFR(1955, 2024, 2050, 2100)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wpp_2024 <- read_rds("wpp_2024.rds")
wpp_TFR <- wpp_2024 |> 
  select(region_name, location_code, type, year, TFR) |> 
  filter(type == "Country/Area", year %in% c(1950, 1990, 2026, 2100)) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(region_name, location_code, type), 
    names_from = year,
    values_from = TFR
  ) |> 
  rename(
    y1950 = `1950`,
    y1990 = `1990`,
    y2026 = `2026`,
    y2100 = `2100`
  )
```
:::


- 결합하기


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
new_world <- countries_m |> 
  left_join(wpp_TFR, join_by(ISO_N3_CD == location_code))
new_tiny <- tiny_m |> 
  left_join(wpp_TFR, join_by(ISO_N3_CD == location_code))
```
:::


### 4가지 계급구분 방법: 서울

#### 평범한 지도

- 최대값과 최소값의 계산


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
min_max <- seoul_df |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  summarize(
    min_value = min(House1_p, na.rm = TRUE), 
    max_value = max(House1_p, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), label_number(accuracy = 0.1)))

min.val <- min_max[[1]]
max.val <- min_max[[2]]
```
:::


- 지도 제작


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
my_map <- tm_shape(seoul_df) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "House1_p", lwd = 0.75, 
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      breaks = c(-Inf, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, Inf),
      labels = c(paste0("< 15", " (Min: ", min.val, ")"),
               "15 ~ 25", "25 ~ 35", "35 ~ 45", "45 ~ 55",
               "55 ~ 65", paste0(">= 65", " (Max: ", max.val, ")")),
      values = "brewer.bu_pu"
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "One-Person (%)", title.size = 1.2, 
      title.align = "center", 
      text.size = 1, item.space = 0
    ),
    fill.chart = tm_chart_histogram(),
  ) +
  tm_shape(seoul_gu) + tm_borders(col = "gray20", lwd = 1.75) +
  tm_title(
    text = "One-Person Households in Seoul, 2020", size = 2, 
    position = c("left", "top")
  ) +
  tm_layout(inner.margins = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05)) + 
  tm_scalebar(color.dark = "gray60", position = c(0.02, 0.030), 
              breaks = seq(0, 20, 5), allow_clipping = TRUE
  ) + 
  tm_credits("SANG-IL LEE, Geography Education at SNU", 
             size = 0.7, position = c(0.78, 0.025)
  )
my_map
```

### 등개수 분류법과 등간격 분류법의 비교: 세계 TFR

#### 등개수 분류법: 1950년

- 지도 제작


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
my_map <- tm_shape(grat_bb_m, crs = "+proj=robin") + tm_borders(lwd = 1) + 
  tm_shape(grat_30_m) + tm_lines(lwd = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(new_world) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "y1950", 
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.reds",
      label.format = tm_label_format(digits = 3)
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "TFR, 1950", title.size = 1.4, text.size = 1.1,
      # position = tm_pos_in("left", "bottom"),
      group_id = "tfr_box"
    ), 
    fill.chart = tm_chart_histogram(
      group_id = "tfr_box"
    )
  ) +
  tm_shape(tiny_m) + tm_dots(size = 0.01) +
  tm_components(
    group_id = "tfr_box",
    position = tm_pos_in("left", "bottom"),
    stack = "vertical", frame = TRUE,
    bg = TRUE, bg.color = "grey95", bg.alpha = 1
  ) +  
  tm_layout(inner.margins = c(0.01, 0.01, 0.02, 0.01), frame = FALSE) +
  tm_credits("SANG-IL LEE, Geography Education at SNU", size = 0.7, position = c(0.87, 0.02))
my_map
```

#### 등간격 분류법: 단절값 계산


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vals <- new_world |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(y1950, y1990, y2026, y2100) |>
  unlist() |>
  as.numeric()
rng <- range(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
brks <- seq(
  from = rng[1],
  to   = rng[2],
  length.out = 6
)[2:5]
```

```{.r .cell-code}
snu.color.scheme.generator <- function(sel, type){
  if (type == "seq"){
    col.schemes <- c("brewer.yl_gn", "brewer.yl_gn_bu", "brewer.gn_bu", "brewer.bu_gn", "brewer.pu_bu_gn", "brewer.pu_bu", "brewer.bu_pu", "brewer.rd_pu", "brewer.pu_rd", "brewer.or_rd", "brewer.yl_or_rd", "brewer.yl_or_br", "brewer.purples", "brewer.blues", "brewer.greens", "brewer.oranges", "brewer.reds", "brewer.greys")
  }
  else if(type == "div"){
    col.schemes <- c("brewer._puor", "brewer.br_bG", "brewer.pr_gn", "brewer.pi_yg", "brewer.rd_bu", "brewer.rd_gy", "brewer.rd_yl_bu", "brewer.spectral", "brewer.rd_ylgn")
  }
  else {col.schemes = c("brewer.set3", "brewer.pastel1", "brewer.set1", "brewer.pastel2", "brewer.set2", "brewer.dark2", "brewer.paired", "brewer.accent")}
  col.sel <- col.schemes[sel]
  n <- length(sel)
  map.name.list <- list()
  i <- 1
  for (i in 1:n){
    my.pal <- col.sel[i]
    var.sel <- "House1_p"
    map.name <- paste0(my.pal, ".map")
    map.name <- tm_shape(seoul_df) + 
      tm_polygons(
        fill = var.sel, 
        fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
          values = my.pal,
          breaks = c(-Inf, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, Inf),
        ),
        fill.legend = tm_legend_hide()
      ) +
      tm_shape(seoul_gu) + tm_borders(lwd = 1.5, col = "black") +
      tm_layout(inner.margins = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05)) +
      tm_credits(text = my.pal, size = 1, position = c(0.05, 0.75))
      map.name.list[[i]] <- map.name
  }
  map.name.list
}
```

```{.r .cell-code}
snu.color.scheme.generator <- function(sel, type){
  if (type == "seq"){
    col.schemes <- c("YlGn", "YlGnBu", "GnBu", "BuGn", "PuBuGn", "PuBu", "BuPu", "RdPu", "PuRd", 
                     "OrRd", "YlOrRd", "YlOrBr", "Purples", "Blues", "Greens", "Oranges", "Reds", "Greys")
  }
  else if(type == "div"){
    col.schemes <- c("PuOr", "BrBG", "PRGn", "PiYG", "RdBu", "RdGy", "RdYlBu", "Spectral", "RdYlGn")
  }
  else {col.schemes = c("Set3", "Pastel1", "Set1", "Pastel2", "Set2", "Dark2", "Paired", "Accent")}
  col.sel <- col.schemes[sel]
  n <- length(sel)
  map.name.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:n){
    my.pal <- col.sel[i]
    var.sel <- "House1_p"
    map.name <- paste0(my.pal, ".map")
    if (type == "seq" | type == "div"){
       map.name <- tm_shape(seoul_df) + 
      tm_polygons(
        fill = var.sel, 
        fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
          values = my.pal,
          breaks = c(-Inf, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, Inf),
        ),
        fill.legend = tm_legend_hide()
      ) +
      tm_shape(seoul_gu) + tm_borders(lwd = 1.5, col = "black") +
      tm_credits(text = my.pal, size = 1, position = c(0.05, 0.95))
      map.name.list[[i]] <- map.name
    }
    else{
      map.name <- tm_shape(seoul_df) +
        tm_polygons(
          fill = "MAP_COLORS",
          fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
            values = my.pal
          )
        ) +
        tm_shape(seoul_gu) + tm_borders(lwd = 1.5, col = "black") +
        tm_credits(text = my.pal, size = 1, position = c(0.05, 0.95))
      map.name.list[[i]] <- map.name
    }
  }
  map.name.list
}
```
